About this item

  • Compatibility: This case Fit for iPhone 15 (6.1 inch, Released in 2023), iPhone 14 (6.1 inch, Released in 2022), iPhone 13 (6.1 inch, Released in 2021). Please confirm your phone moderl before purchasing
  • Strong Magnetic Charging: This iPhone 15 Case has built with 38 super-strong N52 magnets, delivering 2400 gf magnetic attraction—over 7× stronger than standard cases. Ensures a secure, stable connection to Magnetic chargers, power banks, car mounts, and wireless charging stands. Perfectly aligned for fast, stable charging every time
  • Tempered Glass Screen Protector: This iPhone 14 Case includes 1× premium tempered glass screen protector that preserves original touch sensitivity and HD clarity. Offers reliable scratch and drop defense for your Screen, without compromising responsiveness or display quality
  • Translucent Matte Back: This iPhone 13 Case crafted from high-quality matte TPU and translucent PC, this case reveals the phone logo with an elegant, refined finish. The frosted texture delivers a comfortable, non-slip grip, while the nano antioxidant layer effectively resists stains, sweat, and minor scratches—keeping your case clean and clear longer
  • 14FT Military Grade Drop Protection: Phone Case iPhone 15/14/13 has rigid polycarbonate backplate paired with flexible, shock-absorbing TPU bumpers around the edges, plus 4 built-in corner air bags. Provides comprehensive protection against accidental drops, bumps, and impacts
  • Eco-Friendly: Featuring over 50% recycled materials and an eco-certification, this product provides durable protection and sustainable design — all while using safer production processes and supporting worker well-being
  • Versatile Use & Ideal Gift: Designed for daily commutes, car mounts, outdoor activities, and new phones. Great gift for family or friends with sleek matte finish, strong magnetic hold, and drop protection. Suitable for all, style and security for daily use

      The price point of this case and the sleek quality feel of the case is phenomenal it's not bulky cumbersome or intrusive in any way it's just a really sleek design very minimalist but still provides a decent level of protection. if it came with the case alone it would be worth the asking price but it actually comes with a really nice glass screen protector as well or whatever it's made of it's very nice it was actually easy to install it so nice.

      I don't have any pictures of the case because it's currently on my phone but I ordered the Black version of the case. It's got a really soft to touch feel and again it feels very quality and very minimalist it's not intrusive in your pocket it doesn't weigh it down and make your phone which is already heavy enough even heavier it's got a very strong magsafe magnet on it which I use for a mag safe popsocket and it works quite well. It will protect your phone from average bumps bangs drops and falls I wouldn't test it any other thing over 3 ft though however for the price and for what you're ordering you know it's not going to be something that from three or four feet in the air it's going to protect your phone perfectly.

      I actually left my phone on top of my car the other day it's a fairly small CUV crossover about 5 ft tall of course I drove off and the phone with banging off the car it looks like there was significant damage done from the fall even on the corresponding corner of the case there was damage but I believe it was subsequently run over as it was waiting more demolished than it should have been however the case was still usable for the most part however the magsafe magnet did fall out that was kind of disappointing considering that I don't believe the case itself got run over I believe it was just the phone so I'm kind of surprised that it broke the bag safe magnet and popped it out but it is I guess I understandable it did get run over but my point is is that it's not the most solid durable case you're ever going to get your hands on but it also is less than a Happy meal at McDonald's and under normal circumstances in normal day to day use and abuse I believe it will handle just about anything you throw at it in a normal day. And that brings me to the screen protector that also comes with it at that super low price point it's such a nice little screen protector then it was actually easy to install I've installed about 20 screen protectors now and every time they're hard to get the bubbles out different things like that I've literally had them crack in my hand while I was try to squeeze the bubbles out but this thing just went on perfectly the first time and so far I'm I'm perfectly happy with it.

      If you're looking for a sleek minimalistic case to cover your phone and give you a little bit of protection so you can rest a little easier that is not going to hurt your pocket that is bag safe and will work with all bagsafe items and wireless charging magsafe stands all kinds of stuff look no further because this little bugger was a great buy

      Good tight fit compatible with last gen, not bulkier than previous cheap clear TPU case but feels more precisely molded to fit the phone and the corners definitely have more cushioning despite not taking up any more space in hand. I used to have this cheapo sticker ring of flat magnets but the magnet embedded in this case is noticeably way stronger and doesn't take up any extra thickness in the hard back of the case which is super nice.

      Overall great case for a great price, and the magnet is definitely strong enough for any kind of compatible mount or accessory (just remember you won't magically get wireless charging in a phone that doesn't support it already).
